yunjae.desc: Seo Yun-jae, a calm 24-year-old Korean man with short slightly messy black hair, dark brown eyes, a navy blue work jacket with a small orange wrench patch on the chest, a plain gray t-shirt, dark jeans and worn black sneakers

aeliss.desc: Aeliss, an elegant elf woman with long flowing silver-white hair, pointed ears, sea-green eyes, a flowing teal and white robe with silver seashell ornaments, holding a coral staff topped with a glowing aqua pearl

kaiser.desc: Kaiser, a tall broad-shouldered man around forty with slicked-back black hair going gray at the sides, sharp hazel eyes, a smug confident half-smile, a white dress shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a loose black tie, a black belt, charcoal dress trousers, polished black shoes and a silver watch

haeun.desc: Seo Ha-eun, a cheerful 15-year-old Korean girl with long black hair in a high ponytail and straight bangs, big brown eyes, wearing loose light blue pajamas covered in small white stars and fluffy white slippers

grandma.desc: the small kind Korean grandmother with silver hair in a neat low bun, round wire glasses, a gentle wrinkled smile, a cream cable-knit cardigan over a dark floral blouse, a long navy skirt, white socks and black flat shoes

raft.desc: a tiny square wooden raft only two meters wide, made of four plain rough weathered gray-brown planks lashed together with thick tan rope, none of the planks glowing

panel.desc: a floating translucent glowing blue holographic System window with glowing borders and abstract symbols, no readable text

knight.desc: Ostrel, the tall silent armored knight in polished steel-blue plate armor with purple-blue trim, a long dark navy cape and a closed helmet with a narrow glowing blue visor slit and no face visible, a long straight sword

dahye.desc: Yoon Da-hye, a calm capable Korean nurse in her late twenties with dark brown hair in a loose low ponytail and a small silver hair clip, brown eyes, teal hospital scrubs over a black long-sleeve shirt and white sneakers

taegu.desc: Bang Tae-gu, a huge hulking muscular Korean man in his late twenties with a black buzz cut, a thick neck, a cocky grin, a silver chain necklace, a black sleeveless tank top, gray jogger sweatpants and white sneakers

raft1.desc: the tiny two-meter square raft of four weathered gray-brown planks lashed with thick tan rope, one of the planks smooth dark wood with a soft green glow

raft2.desc: the three-meter square raft of weathered gray planks lashed with tan rope, one smooth dark plank glowing green, a short mast with a small patched cream sail, a wooden storage crate and a fishing rod in a rope holder

raft3.desc: the four-meter square log-framed raft with raised edges, one plank glowing green, a small wooden roof shelter, two rain-catching barrels with cloth funnels, a small iron stove and a patched cream sail

raft4.desc: the small twin-hull wooden catamaran with a flat plank deck, a rope railing, a little wooden cabin with a round window, a white sail, and one dark plank glowing green in the middle of the deck

raft5.desc: the small armored sailing ship with dark wooden hulls reinforced with riveted steel plates, white sails with a faint purple shimmer, a crow's nest, two mounted deck crossbows, a small cabin, and one dark plank glowing green in the center of the deck

raft2_plain.desc: a three-meter square raft of weathered gray planks lashed with tan rope, a short mast with a small patched cream sail, a wooden storage crate and a fishing rod in a rope holder, every deck plank plain with no glow

raft3_plain.desc: a four-meter square log-framed raft with raised edges, a small wooden roof shelter, two rain-catching barrels with cloth funnels, a small iron stove and a patched cream sail, every deck plank plain with no glow

raft4_plain.desc: a small twin-hull wooden catamaran with a flat plank deck, a rope railing, a little wooden cabin with a round window, a white sail, every deck plank plain with no glow

raft5_plain.desc: a small armored sailing ship with dark wooden hulls reinforced with riveted steel plates, white sails with a faint purple shimmer, a crow's nest, two mounted deck crossbows, a small cabin, every deck plank plain with no glow

jiho.desc: Noh Ji-ho, a skinny nervous Korean man in his early twenties with messy brown hair, round thin-framed glasses, big anxious brown eyes, an oversized gray hoodie, a black backpack, loose dark gray sweatpants and white slip-on sneakers
